text:
Sam: OK team, finalizing the benchmark narrative for the launch + webinar. Primary deliverable: a single hero "unit economics heatmap" (latency p95 vs $/1M tokens) + a tiny micro-calculator for quick estimates. ETA: next Tue.
Irene: I'll export p50/p95 and $/1M tokens for hosted/dedicated/private across seq lengths 64/256/1024. Heatmap sounds goodut let's ensure p95 axis highlights tail differences.
Leo: Audience split: devs (time-to-prod & cost) and infra/platform (SLOs and predictability). We'll need two headline variants and CTA routing.
Ava: Visual idea: heatmap background for cost bands with overlaid latency contours + dots for configurations. Keep hero clean for social. I can do 1200x628 + 800x800 + webinar slide.
Ravi: Product note: add a compact callout about SLO bucketing and smart routing (e.g., route non-critical traffic to quantized variants during pressure). Ops teams want that example.
Irene: Data caveat: quantization reduces unit costs but sometimes widens p95. I'll provide solid lines for base, dashed for quantized, and a small CSV link.
Sam: Copy candidates: A) "Understand latency economics at a glance." B) "Optimize p95 without surprise bills." Which maps where?
Leo: A -> social (curiosity), B -> webinar/landing (enterprise). CTAs: "Try the calc" vs "Book a capacity consult". Use UTMs to route.
Ava: Design constraints: avoid micro text on images; put methodology and footnotes on the landing page and link to raw CSV. Also include a neutral grayscale slide variant.
Irene: Deliverables: CSV + compact JSON for the micro-calculator (seq, tps -> est $/month) by tomorrow AM. I'll annotate any "up to" claims.
Ravi: Webinar flow: 1) framing: why latency economics matter (5m) 2) demo: routing + micro-calc (10m) 3) bench walkthrough (10m) 4) customer vignette (8m) 5) Q&A (7m). Keep ~40m.
Leo: Lead routing: ad clicks -> landing; hidden form field for company size to auto-tag enterprise. A/B test headline variants for 72h, route higher-quality leads to AE.
Ava: For hero image, I'll make two headline-lockups so we can swap copy quickly. Also export a PNG with the small p50/p95 table embedded for slides.
Sam: Ops: ci-bot, schedule the review?
ci-bot: Calendar event created: "Bench Launch Review" Mon 10:00.
Irene: I'll add a tiny table for embeddings cost too in case growth wants to call that out.
Ravi: Legal note: avoid absolute % claims in social. Use "up to" and link to raw numbers.
Sam: Action items: @Irene data exports + JSON (tomorrow AM). @Ava mockups for three sizes (tomorrow noon). @Leo landing copy + UTM plan + email cadence (Wed EOD). @Ravi webinar deck + FAQ (Wed EOD). I'll collate assets and run a pre-launch signoff Thurs.
Ava: :thumbsup: Will share color options and iterate quickly.
Irene: Sending initial CSV in the morning, will flag any risky comparisons.
Sam: Thanks all  Will post the compile doc here once assets arrive. Flag any blockers ASAP. :rocket:
